status: Independent confirmation and original instructional plan
independent_methods: Wealth-floor feasible-vertex intersections from four primitive halfplanes; analytic all-B lower bound.
Weighted Gram solution for two active utility constraints, then global convex tangent certificates.
Independent branchwise quadratic wage allocation and later-exit constraints.
Bellman evaluation at both public states and every payment choice; all behavioral deviations handled analytically.
proof_choices: Finite static common wage interval, every-action global IC, sufficient dual certificates without unqualified necessity.

Finite promise theorem covers deterministic wage trees and pure public recommendations; no public lotteries, private credit or persistent hidden state. Bounded-wage theorem and uncapped example solved separately; cap4 preserves the example optima.
Relational equilibrium allows arbitrary behavioral/private-history effort deviations and all feasible discretionary payments, within the explicitly fixed bonus game.
Weak IC and participation ties select the recommendation/continuation. Strict limits are stated separately.
originality: All six cases use root original laws, independently verified; new third-action, ancillary, measurement-fee and failure-trigger transfers extend them. Monetary and utility units remain distinct.
